description: This file provides Python classes that wrap and delegate to C++ frontend modules in PyTorch, enabling Python-C++ interoperation for neural network modules.

classes.name: OrderedDictWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around a C++ OrderedDict that dynamically evaluates the getter on a bound C++ module.

classes.name: ModuleWrapper
classes.description: A subclass of torch.nn.Module that wraps a C++ frontend module and delegates all access, enabling Python-C++ interoperation.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with a C++ module and attribute name.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.cpp_dict
methods.description: Property that retrieves the C++ OrderedDict via getattr.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.items
methods.description: Returns items of the wrapped C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.keys
methods.description: Returns keys of the wrapped C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.values
methods.description: Returns values of the wrapped C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.__iter__
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.__len__
methods.description: Returns the length of the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.__contains__
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: OrderedDictWrapper.__getitem__
methods.description: Gets an item from the C++ OrderedDict.

methods.name: ModuleWrapper.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the ModuleWrapper with a C++ module, sets up wrapped attributes.

methods.name: ModuleWrapper._apply
methods.description: Applies a function to all parameters and buffers, optionally recursively.

methods.name: ModuleWrapper.training (getter)
methods.description: Returns the training mode of the C++ module.

methods.name: ModuleWrapper.training (setter)
methods.description: Sets the training mode of the C++ module.

methods.name: ModuleWrapper.__repr__
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the C++ module.
